description.value:
Cybersuite · Neuralware, Hospital, HL 7 (2d6), 1 Neural Link slot. Requires a Neuroport. Installs one Cyberdeck inside your Neuroport, Hardware slots and all: 20m to architectures, 50m to Neuroports and vehicles. Swapping the deck is a Clinic job (1 hour).

Built-in quickhacks (take no deck slots, can't be removed): Short Circuit, Overheat

Reroll the lowest damage die on its built-in quickhacks (keep the new roll). Any quickhack you run that beats its DV by 2 or less fries: 1d6 to your HP.

5,000eb (Luxury).
